title: checktor 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2026-07-02 Initial release. Adds checktor() top-level orchestrator, running five categories diagnostics (code, DESCRIPTION, documentation, general, CRAN policy) R package directory. Adds checkup() boolean wrapper CI use, prescribe() treatment recommendations, health_report() Markdown / HTML / text reports. code-side diagnostics run XPath queries parsed AST via xmlparsedata + xml2. Documentation-side checks walk .Rd files via tools::parse_Rd(). DESCRIPTION parsed base::read.dcf(). Added result accessors longer navigate nested lists: issues() (per-issue table), tidy() (per-check table), summary() (per-category), plus passed(), is_healthy(), n_issues(), n_failed_checks(), failed_checks(). .data.frame() result equivalent tidy(). General: flags missing NEWS file (diagnose_news_file()) README relative links whose target missing excluded .Rbuildignore absent built tarball (diagnose_readme_relative_links()). diagnose_cran_comments_file() also provided , since cran-comments.md workflow convention rather CRAN requirement, opt-part default checktor() run. DESCRIPTION: flags Title fields 65 characters, single-quoted function names Title/Description (quotes software names), -capitalized small words Title. Documentation: flags exported functions whose .Rd lacks \examples section (diagnose_missing_examples()) examples use Suggested package without requireNamespace() / @examplesIf guard (diagnose_suggested_in_examples()).
